title: Newly Established Medical Tourism Company for Sale in Dubai, UAE
tagline: * Early-stage medical tourism marketplace registered in the UAE, connecting GCC patients with accredited clinics in Egypt for dental, cosmetic, and specialized procedures. * Operates through a live, custom-built platform featuring AI-powered specialist matching, online consultations, a support ticketing system, and admin and SEO dashboards. * Holds signed partnership agreements with prestigious clinics in Cairo, with contracts held by the company entity and transferable through a share sale. * Revenue model is commission per completed patient case, charged to the provider, with an additional broker referral program in place. * Has completed its first paying patient cases, validating the full funnel from paid acquisition to lead, quotation, travel, and commission collection. * Generates inbound leads through established social media channels and paid campaigns on Meta and TikTok, supported by growing organic traffic. * Registered as a free zone LLC in Ras Al Khaimah with a Trade license valid until June next year and a clean compliance record, including a filed UAE Corporate Tax return. * Promoter brings 15+ years of product leadership experience across GCC healthcare, fintech, and marketplace businesses, including national-scale government platforms. * The company is offered as a full sale of the entity, including the license, platform, brand, clinic agreements, lead database, and social media accounts.
